title: List request (input, contract v0)
description: A request to agentspace lease list. The v0 CLI takes it as flags and arguments only and never reads this document; it defines the request for validation, and for the hosted API (#0011), which takes it as JSON. Both filters are optional, and null means not given. An empty state array is refused, because it could mean every state or none. See docs/lease-api.md.

project.description: Only this project's leases. Letters, digits and '-', 1 to 32, in any case.

state.description: Only leases in this state, or in any of these states. State names in any case.
